prompt: Your scholarship can only be paid into a bank account in your name. Find what the bank needs and put it in the folder.
summary: Your folder is ready. Now you can open the account.

aadhaar.why: This proves who you are and where you live. The bank needs it.

photo.why: The bank keeps a photo on your file. Take two, they always ask for a spare.

school_id.why: A school or college ID helps the bank confirm you are a student.

sibling_id.why: This is your brother's ID. The bank needs yours — the account is in your name.

cinema_ticket.why: Not this one. A ticket does not prove who you are.

guardian_id.why: You are under 18, so this is a minor account. A parent or guardian signs with you, and the bank needs their ID too.

electricity_bill.text: The electricity bill for your house
electricity_bill.why: A recent bill proves your address. Any utility bill in the family's name usually works.

pan.why: PAN links your account to your tax record. Worth having before your first salary.

concept.kyc: KYC means Know Your Customer. It is the bank checking that you are really you.

missing.hook: You cannot find your Aadhaar card anywhere.
missing.explain: This happens. You can apply at an Aadhaar centre — it takes a few weeks, and the account can wait that long. Nothing is lost.
